title: Feature context
description: One per feature (e2e/context/<feature>.feature.yaml). What a human tester would want to know before writing tests for it.

feature.description: Slug. Spec files for this feature are named <feature>.spec.ts.

risk.description: high: money, data loss, privacy, sign-in. Drives how many edge cases the planner writes.

entry.description: Path where the feature starts, relative to baseURL.

personas.description: Persona ids from app.yaml that use this feature.

rules.description: Business rules that must always hold. Each one should end up asserted by at least one test.

given.description: Preconditions, in terms of the data fixtures.

known_issues.description: Bugs or flakiness already known, so agents don't report them as new or 'heal' around them.
